observations: 2015 study tested cationic nanogel delivery of Runx2 and Osterix siRNAs in rhBMP-2-stimulated MC3T3-E1.4 preosteoblasts.
After 21 days, nanogel-siRNA treatment significantly decreased hydroxyapatite deposition versus rhBMP-2-only cultures (OsteoImage assay, p<0.001); mineralization remained above non-rhBMP-2 cultures.
qRT-PCR reductions in Runx2 and Osx were approximately 43–52% across tested nanogel:siRNA ratios; reported p<0.001.
